Meet Mark

A lifelong dog person

I come from a multigenerational family of dog lovers. I grew up surrounded by dogs, and they've always been an important part of my life. I genuinely love their companionship and individual personalities, and I bring that same affection and attentiveness to every dog I walk.

I've been a resident of Brentwood for over 11 years, and I especially love all the dogs...everywhere!

Dog Walking Services

Booking and confirmation. A walk is scheduled only once Mark confirms it directly by phone, text, or email. A booking request on its own does not reserve a time.

Cancellations. Walks may be cancelled at no charge with at least 24 hours' notice. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice are charged 50% of the walk fee. Same-day cancellations after Mark has arrived, and no-shows, are charged the full fee.

Access. You are responsible for providing reliable access to your dog, including keys, gate or door codes, and building entry. If Mark arrives at the scheduled time and cannot reach your dog because of an access problem, the full fee applies.

Weather and safety. Mark may shorten, reschedule, or cancel a walk because of extreme heat, poor air quality, heavy rain, or other unsafe conditions. You will not be charged for a walk Mark cancels.

Payment. Payment is due upon completion of each walk, or on the invoice schedule agreed for recurring walks, and is made through PayPal to Artist Arrow LLC.

Health and vaccinations. Your dog must be licensed and current on rabies vaccination as required by Los Angeles County, and should be current on other core vaccinations. You agree to tell Mark about any medical conditions, medications, injuries, or physical limitations before the first walk and whenever they change.

Behavior. You agree to disclose any history of biting, aggression, reactivity toward people or other dogs, escaping, or other behavior that could affect safety. Mark may decline or end service for any dog he believes cannot be walked safely.

Equipment. All walks are on-leash. You agree to provide a secure, well-fitted collar or harness with current ID tags, and a leash in good condition.

Emergencies. If your dog is injured or becomes ill during a walk and you cannot be reached, you authorize Mark to obtain veterinary care, using your regular veterinarian where practical. You are responsible for all resulting veterinary costs.

Owner responsibility. You remain responsible for your dog's behavior, including any injury or damage your dog causes to people, other animals, or property, except where caused by Mark's negligence. Artist Arrow LLC is not liable for illness, injury, or loss that is not caused by its negligence.

Keys. Keys and access codes are kept secure and used only to provide services. Keys are returned when service ends.

Photos. Mark may take photos of your dog during walks to share with you. Photos are posted on social media only with your permission.
